title: More Fruits 2
description: Another auther to add more fruits into Minecraft
body:
This mod is made with MCreator

Expanding the MCreator-made More Fruits mod, this upgraded version enriches Minecraft’s gameplay with diverse fresh fruits and exclusive golden variants, boasting unique buffs for an enhanced survival experience. The standout Golden Strawberry delivers powerful effects: 120 seconds of Absorption I for extra defense and 10 seconds of Health Boost II for instant vitality recovery. Crafted via MCreator’s intuitive tools, it blends creative design with practical combat utility, making exploration and battles more strategic and fun for all players.

This mod add some fruits and it's golden modality:
Golden Strawberry:
Absorption I      120 seconds
Health Boost II   10 seconds
